title: Connect 0.1.0-0057
body:
<!-- synopkgland:release:synopackageland%2FSynoPkgConnect:0.1.0-0057 -->

Connect **0.1.0-0057**

0.1.0-0057
- Rebuild with SDK/CLI/templates 0.15.1 and UI 0.11.5.
- SDK control.sh refusals remove staged .executor / .policy.json and log the package name. Changed executor task definitions require one administrator reapproval after upgrade for Apps using the executor; Connect has no executor or approval flow.
- AboutDialog no longer supplies default Terms of Service / Privacy URLs. Connect and its SDK AppShell do not use AboutDialog and display no legal links.

Package: `synopackageland/SynoPkgConnect`

[Browse packages](https://synopkgland.com/apps/)
